Problem: Configured historical model is unavailable; provenance/license/labels unknown
Solution: Select or recover model; approve license; pin revision and SHA-256; require safetensors
Expected effect: Unlock reproducible inference without silent substitution
Risk of change: Wrong replacement model or license decision
Acceptance criteria: Manifest contains source/license/revision/hash/id2label/processor and passes clean-cache load
Effect measurement: Artifact manifest verification and real-model smoke

Recommendation: Approve intended purpose and claim boundary
Solution: Controlled intended-purpose statement; retain research-only public wording until evidence exists
Expected effect: Prevents unsafe scope drift and determines data/regulatory plan
Effect measurement: Claim-to-evidence review has no unsupported clinical claim

Problem: Processor-model-logit-label path has never been reproduced
Solution: Clean environment and offline container smoke using approved manifest and golden images
Expected effect: Closes G1 and detects inverted labels/preprocessing mismatch
Acceptance criteria: Cold and offline smoke pass on supported Python/container with recorded hashes
Effect measurement: Repeatability across two clean installs and supported Python versions

Solution: Prespecified multi-site patient-grouped protocol with locked test and reference standard
Expected effect: Estimates clinical performance and closes G2 only if targets pass
Risk of change: Spectrum bias insufficient positives or protocol deviation
Acceptance criteria: Protocol frozen before test; patient-level Se/Sp CI/subgroups reported; independent review
Effect measurement: Prespecified primary endpoints and confidence intervals

Recommendation: Implement biological QC OOD and reject option
Problem: Decoder validation cannot identify wrong cell/stain/focus/domain
Solution: Image-quality model/rules; OOD benchmark; calibrated selective classification; human escalation
Expected effect: Reduces confident errors on unusable or shifted inputs
Risk of change: Rejects may be biased or excessive
Acceptance criteria: Locked risk-coverage and subgroup thresholds meet review capacity and safety constraints
Effect measurement: Quality failure rate OOD FPR95 coverage/selective risk

Recommendation: Establish regulatory strategy and controlled QMS scope
Problem: Medical/IVD applicability and controlled lifecycle are unresolved
Solution: Market-specific classification memo; QMS/risk/software/usability/cybersecurity artifact plan
Expected effect: Avoids building evidence that cannot support intended market
Acceptance criteria: Approved applicability memo and controlled artifact owners/change process
Effect measurement: Gap closure rate and audit-ready traceability

Recommendation: Validate slide aggregation and mandatory human review
Problem: Single-cell score cannot support patient result
Solution: Detection/counting coverage; hierarchical aggregation; minimum count; review/override/escalation
Expected effect: Creates auditable slide workflow without independence fallacy
Acceptance criteria: Patient safety gate P0-P6 passes; usability hazards controlled
Effect measurement: Patient-level errors override quality review time and parasitemia agreement

Recommendation: Create patient-slide-cell data registry and leakage controls
Problem: Dataset lineage and patient-grouped split are unavailable
Solution: Versioned datasheet/consent/license/lineage; exact/perceptual duplicates; patient split enforcement
Expected effect: Makes statistical validation identifiable and reproducible
Dependencies: Data access legal basis storage design
Acceptance criteria: Zero cross-split linked cases; immutable manifest; privacy review
Effect measurement: Leakage rate duplicate clusters and manifest completeness

Recommendation: Calibrate scores and validate selective classification
Problem: Softmax confidence is uncalibrated and cannot express safe uncertainty
Solution: Separate calibration set; temperature baseline; Brier/NLL/ECE; reject threshold from clinical loss
Expected effect: Improves score semantics and enables indeterminate response
Acceptance criteria: Calibration/test separation proven; CI and risk-coverage meet prespecified targets
Effect measurement: Brier ECE calibration slope/intercept coverage and selective risk

Recommendation: Add deployment identity quotas and global rate limiting
Problem: Anonymous callers can exhaust inference resources
Solution: Gateway authentication; per-principal quotas; global concurrency/rate/body/time limits
Expected effect: Bounds abuse and provides accountable access
Acceptance criteria: Unauthorized requests rejected; overload stays within RSS/latency budgets; audit events contain principal alias
Effect measurement: Abuse-test rejection rate queue depth RSS and 5xx

Problem: Dependencies/base/model/container are not fully immutable or signed
Solution: Hash lock; base digest; scans; SBOM; model/container signatures and provenance policy
Expected effect: Reduces rebuild drift and tampering risk
Acceptance criteria: Offline verified build; policy rejects mutable/untrusted artifacts
Effect measurement: Rebuild digest parity CVE policy and signature verification

Recommendation: Deploy internal metrics alerts and runbooks
Solution: Protected metrics/traces; dashboards; alert tests; privacy-approved retention; incident runbooks
Expected effect: Shortens detection/recovery and supports error budgets
Acceptance criteria: Alert injection tests pass; no forbidden labels; on-call runbooks exercised
Effect measurement: MTTD MTTR alert precision queue/reject/model status

Acceptance criteria: Repeatable report covers c=1/2/4/8/16 and overload recovery within budgets
Effect measurement: p50-p99 throughput RSS CPU error and timeout rates
